verdict.line: You lose if Irelia hits three or more Bladesurges through minions before level 6; you win if you survive to Needlework and outscale in extended fights.

brief.thesis: Irelia's Q (Bladesurge) resets off minions and champions alike, letting her dash-reset her way through the wave to poke you down without ever entering your Q (Snip Snip!) range on her own terms. Gwen has no way to punish that dash pattern before level 6, so this lane is a defensive holding pattern until Needlework gives you a long-range poke tool she can't Bladesurge away from.

theirWindow.when: she has 2+ minions low and Q up
theirWindow.what: She can chain Bladesurge resets through the wave to stack Ionian Fervor attack speed and crash into you at range you didn't expect. Back off wave and don't contest the low-health minions she's setting up to reset off.

yourWindow.when: her Q is on cooldown and W is down
yourWindow.what: This is your only safe trade window pre-6. Walk up, land 3-4 snips with Q (Snip Snip!) for the true damage tick, then E (Skip 'n Slash) out before she can charge W (Defiant Dance) to punish the stand-still.

powerCurve.note: Fervor stacks + E stun win extended trades
Needlework adds poke, she still resets

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: 52.6% win rate over 390 games; the extra potion charge is what lets you actually stand in Bladesurge range and trade instead of permanently backing off.

boots.why: 53% win rate over 279 games; the flat physical damage reduction directly cuts into her auto-reset damage and Fervor-stacked autos.

core.why: Core first item in the highest win-rate path (64.5% over 62 games), builds toward the burst that punishes her all-in windows.
Amplifies your Q true damage and Needlework poke once you've built Dusk and Dawn, converting lane pressure into kill threat.
64.5% win rate path; by this point you're outscaling her flat AD scaling with pure magic burst.

situational.when: she is snowballing kills and diving you with Q resets
the game goes long and you need sustain damage in extended teamfights

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through the extended trades this lane forces, and the healing on stacked Conqueror offsets the sustained poke damage Irelia deals through minion resets.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the highest win rate and pick rate combo (52.5%, 62.1% pick); Ignite punishes her all-in windows since Bladesurge healing otherwise lets her walk away from bad trades.

playing.title: Never stand still under her Q
playing.detail: Bladesurge dashes to a target within 600 range and refreshes on kill or mark. Keep moving through minion waves so she can't line up a free reset onto you.

playing.title: Trade only when her Q is down
playing.detail: Watch her Q cooldown (10-6s depending on rank) — that's your entire trading window pre-6. Outside of it, hold Hallowed Mist (W) in reserve rather than trading.

playing.title: Respect the E stun windup
playing.detail: Flawless Duet (E) sends two converging blades that stun and Mark on hit, cooldown 16-10s. Don't stand between her and a minion or you'll eat the stun into a full combo.

playing.title: Use W to dodge all-ins, not to farm
playing.detail: Hallowed Mist only protects you from enemies outside it and has an 18-22s cooldown — save it for her Q+E all-in combo, not passive laning.

playing.title: Poke with Q, disengage with E
playing.detail: Snip Snip! hits in a cone up to 6 times with true damage in the center; land a few snips then use Skip 'n Slash to dash away before she can punish the stand-still.

playing.title: Needlework changes the lane at 6
playing.detail: Once you have Needlework, you can poke from 1200 range where she has no Bladesurge target. Start chunking her from range instead of engaging in scissors range.

playing.title: Don't force fights before level 9
playing.detail: Her Ionian Fervor stacks and Q resets win short trades against you until your Shadowflame burst comes online — play for scaling, not lane kills.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, win rates, and pick rates above are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch (16.18.1); the tactical reading of cooldowns, ability mechanics, and trade windows is my own analysis.
